description: After you consulted Phaedo and the USER decided what to do, record their outcome on the receipt: approved | rejected | modified | unknown. Record what the USER chose, NOT whether you proceeded. A rejected/modified outcome teaches Phaedo how the user wants delegated work handled (the act-as-me channel). Defaults to the most recent receipt; pass receipt_id to mark a specific one.
name: phaedo_record_outcome
title: Record what the subject decided about a consulted action
